exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.cue: Hold the seat, feet flat. Lift your heels, then lower them. Go at your own pace and breathe naturally.

exercises.name: Seated knee lift
exercises.cue: Sit tall, hold the seat and lift one knee at a time.

exercises.name: March in place
exercises.cue: March on the spot, knees up to a comfortable height, arms swinging easily.

exercises.name: Standing stretch
exercises.cue: Reach both arms overhead, lengthen through your sides, then relax.

exercises.name: Desk stretch
exercises.cue: Hands on the desk edge, step back and hinge forward until you feel your back and shoulders open.

exercises.name: Neck and shoulders
exercises.cue: Roll your shoulders back slowly, then tilt your head gently side to side.
